m12.run: Night under a concrete road flyover in London, sodium light falling through the gap between the carriageways and a haze hanging in it. The man in the attached reference raps straight at the lens, shot from a low angle at knee height, framed from his boots to above his head. He is caught lunging forward onto his front foot, knees deeply bent, torso pitched toward the camera, a handheld microphone pressed to his mask with the elbow high, his free gloved arm thrust out with the index finger stabbing right at the viewer. Empty concrete stretches to his left. His mask has the white ring and a small red triangle over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words in the frame.

s01.run: Night, a narrow London brick alley with wheelie bins along one wall and a wall vent pouring steam into the lamplight. A wide shot straight down the alley from waist height, the man in the attached reference small enough that the whole of him and the ground around him are in frame. He is mid-stride coming toward the camera, weight rolling onto one foot, shoulders dipped and swinging, both gloved arms out from his sides, one hand flicked open at the lens and the other pointing back over his shoulder. Mask with the white ring and a small red triangle over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words anywhere.

s02.run: Wet night under a motorway flyover, rain dripping from the concrete edge, an oil drum fire throwing orange light and sparks upward. Medium-wide shot from just behind the drum, low, flames soft in the foreground. The man in the attached reference is crouched low on the far side of the fire, one knee nearly down on the wet ground, springing up, a handheld microphone gripped tight to his mask and his free gloved arm flung out wide to the side, palm open, as if pointing at a shop door far off frame. Puddles reflect the fire. Mask with the white ring and a small red triangle over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Gloves on, no skin. No readable words in the frame.

s03.run: Dusk on a flat London rooftop, the city lighting up below in purple and orange haze, a vent stack and a low parapet behind. Full-length shot from slightly above and to one side, the skyline wrapping round him with open sky for his raised arm. The man in the attached reference is caught mid-hop, both feet just off the gravel, knees tucked, chin jutting forward, one gloved fist thrown straight up and the other hand flicking a mocking pointed finger down at the city below. No microphone, both hands free. Mask with the white ring and a small red triangle over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words anywhere in the frame.

s04.run: Night in a narrow London brick alley, dense graffiti shapes on the wall behind, no readable letters, a single amber lamp and a bin edge in the dark. Three-quarter side angle from very low near the ground, framed from mid-thigh to above his head with space ahead of him. The man in the attached reference is in a deep wide stance, knees bent, torso tipped forward hard, a handheld microphone held to his mask with the elbow out, his free gloved forearm swung high above his head like a hammer at the top of a downward strike. Mask with the white ring and a small red triangle over his left eye, on the right of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words in the frame.

s05.run: Night under a concrete flyover, small tents behind and a drum fire throwing orange light up from below. Full-body shot from ground level, the lens low and close to his boots, looking up. The man in the attached reference is caught mid-rap in a deep crouch: feet wide, knees bent hard, torso pitched forward over the lens, a handheld microphone gripped tight to his mask, his free arm thrust straight at the camera with one gloved finger pointing. Smoke and sparks rise past him. Space above his head and to his right. Mask: white ring round the face, small red triangle high over his left eye, no eye or mouth openings. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

s06.run: Night on the Thames embankment, the river wall running diagonally away, lamp light on wet stone, his small green tent beside him. Wide shot at eye level from a few metres along the wall. The man in the attached reference is mid-stride, prowling toward the camera, one boot up on the low step of the wall, shoulders rolled forward, head jutting. One gloved arm swings out wide and stiff as if holding a door open; the other hand is cupped out at the lens like a bowl. Empty pavement ahead of him for the walk. Mask: white ring round the face, small red triangle high over his left eye, no eye or mouth openings. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

t04.run: Bright overcast day on a glass-walled rooftop terrace in the City of London, office towers behind. Full shot from knee height, slightly wide lens. The man in the attached reference strides toward the camera with a lordly swagger: chest out, chin tipped up, leaning back from the waist, feet mid-step on the decking. A handheld microphone is held near his mask with the elbow cocked high and out; his free hand is raised flat, palm down, at the top of a chopping stroke. Clear space to his left for him to pace. Mask: white ring round the face, small red triangle high over his left eye, no eye or mouth openings. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

t03.run: Evening in a fine-dining restaurant, dark panelled walls, brass table lamps glowing, diners blurred behind. Medium-wide shot from table height across a white tablecloth, glasses in the foreground. The man in the attached reference has risen from his seat and stands with one foot planted up on his chair, knee high, leaning right over the table toward the lens, one gloved hand braced flat on the cloth, the other arm raised behind his head mid-swing, finger pointed down at the camera as if at someone beneath him. Head room above the raised hand. Mask: white ring round the face, small red triangle high over his left eye, no eye or mouth openings. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

t05.run: Full-body shot from a low angle on the aft deck of a big white motor yacht at sea on a clear day, the camera at knee height near the stern rail looking up, wake and open blue water behind. The man in the attached reference strides toward the lens in a wide, swaggering stance, chest thrown out, weight on his front foot, knees bent. His gloved right hand holds a handheld microphone tight to his mask, elbow high and out. His free arm is flung out sideways, palm open, as if presenting the whole yacht. Empty teak deck to his left for him to stroll. His mask has no eye or mouth openings: a white ring round the face, a small red triangle high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on, cuffs over wrists, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

t06.run: Wide shot on a private tropical beach on a bright day, the camera low on the sand looking up, palms and a white sun lounger behind him, sea glittering. The man in the attached reference has just sprung up off the lounger and lunges at the lens, torso pitched hard forward, one knee bent deep, the other leg driving back in the sand. No microphone: both gloved arms are thrown forward, one finger stabbing straight at the camera, the other hand open and spread in outrage. Plenty of empty sand on either side and sky above his hands. His mask has no eye or mouth openings: a white ring round the face, a small red triangle high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.

t07.run: Three-quarter full shot in an underground car park, cold strip lights overhead reflecting off a glossy black luxury saloon, the camera low by its front wheel looking up along the bonnet. The man in the attached reference has one polished shoe planted up on the front bumper, leaning his whole body over his raised knee toward the lens, head jutting forward. His gloved left hand holds a handheld microphone against his mask; his right hand is raised high beside his head, flicking a blank platinum card between two gloved fingers. Concrete space ahead of him for movement. His mask has no eye or mouth openings: a white ring round the face, a small red triangle high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. Number plate blank, no readable words.

t08.run: Medium-wide shot at a warm-evening garden party at an English country house, golden light, the camera low at the pool edge looking up, blurred guests in suits holding champagne behind him. The man in the attached reference stands up on a wrought-iron garden chair above the crowd, legs wide, knees bent, rocking back. His gloved right hand grips a handheld microphone at his mask; his gloved left hand thrusts a full champagne flute straight up in the air like a trophy, arm fully extended, with clear sky above it. Two guests turn to cheer with raised glasses. His mask has no eye or mouth openings: a white ring round the face, a small red triangle high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on, no skin anywhere. No readable words.
